timestampConvention: UTC ISO-8601 TEXT; no added format or ordering validation

assertion: Fresh shared SQLite initialization creates tickets with stable id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY usable by future child references; retain shared standalone/server setup without automatic ticket creation.
Reporter/category/service foreign keys are required; technician/verifier/closer user references allow NULL but enforce existing parents when supplied. No user-role or technician-eligibility logic.
Require description, impact and urgency at insertion; impact/urgency accept low/medium/high. Calculated priority allows NULL or P1/P2/P3/P4 without an algorithm or SLA duration mapping.

Require caller-supplied service_criticality_snapshot low/medium/high/critical from the selected service at insertion; later source changes do not change it. No copy trigger, creation workflow or continuous equality gate.

Require caller-supplied created_at; omitted status defaults open, explicit NULL status fails, allowed statuses are open/assigned/in_progress/resolved/verified/closed. assigned_at/resolved_at/verified_at/closed_at and resolution_summary/closure_summary are nullable; no transition, event-order or completion gates.
response_due_at and resolution_due_at are nullable stored snapshots, not silently recalculated after external policy edits. No SLA policy table/FK, store/reader, calculator or fixed targets.

Repeated shared initialization preserves parents, tickets, identities, state, summaries and snapshots and retains path, FK, standalone lifecycle and prototype-users rejection; no reset, conversion, reseeding or migration framework.

No ticket API/UI, assignment/role authorization, transitions, priority/SLA calculation, external policy persistence, child tables, notifications/reporting, account changes, Java persistence, live data changes, unrelated dependencies/migrations, merge or push.
READY: clarified todo resolves OPEN-01 through OPEN-03; package is specification authority, not implementation or verification evidence.
